purpose: Public counter-UAS radar reference; civilian-only restriction does not apply. Reference metadata, not a detection model or selected installation.

conditions: 12 km is the optional long-range instrumented mode, not a guaranteed small-drone detection range.
Rotation and update interval are separate quantities; the document describes back-to-back radar antennas.
Manufacturer detection and classification claims depend on target and viewing, clutter and weather conditions; they are not interchangeable.
profiles.simulation_use: Reference only. Current 12-second sweep and 1000 m display radius are illustrative and are not IRIS emulation.
